key_idea: Counting partitions into powers of m is unbounded coin change with coins 1, m, m^2, ... (at most ~9 coins for n <= 10000).
sketch: For each test build dp[0]=1 and for every power p of m not exceeding n do dp[i]+=dp[i-p] for i from p to n. That is O(n log_m n) per data set, about 1e8 simple operations in the worst case over 1000 sets, fine. The answer fits in unsigned 32 bits, so use unsigned (or 64-bit) arithmetic, not signed int. Print the data set number before the answer.
